forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.subtitle: We'll send a 6-digit verification code to your email (if SMTP is configured). Otherwise, check the backend terminal for the code.

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your email and choose a new password. If SMTP is not set up, check the backend terminal for the code.

config.recaptchaNotConfigured: reCAPTCHA is not configured. Set REACT_APP_RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY in client/.env and restart the frontend to enable it.
